components.name: Open timber gallery bay
components.function: Need rock-seat/platform junctions, timber post/rail/bracket modules, stepped gallery landings and roof corner/eave assemblies. Lantern, jade/teal tile and lattice motifs already shown. Ferns/moss/local conifers, quiet moths/owls proposed; water drops use shared family. Provide missing isolated hosts and join views.
components.construction: One isolated open timber gallery bay matching the supplied building, its roof/arch/wall silhouette and local materials. Show front and interior/rear/underside contact, not a complete building scene. Actual open column galleries and holes stay open. Extend hidden depth only enough to form a joinable section; no palace-wide plan or added unrelated tower.
components.attachment_face: Underside/root to ground or declared host; keep true openings clear
components.semantic_front: Main visible face +Y and Zup; sides are actual thickness, not flattened painting
components.design_basis: Visible source vocabulary with missing construction views or new habitat forms; metrics and hidden surfaces proposed
